items.note: Midjourney isn't named, but the prompt uses Midjourney syntax (--ar, --no), so it's clearly written for that tool.
--ar 4:5 sets the portrait feed format. Instagram isn't named, but the aspect ratio is correct.
'a latte with a clearly defined leaf latte art in a handmade ceramic cup' covers this and stresses the latte art.
'a single autumn leaf resting beside the cup' is included.
'--no ... text, logo' excludes text and logos.
